results.title: Nebulabrot 16k 5000 500 50.png
results.desc: A rendering of the Buddhabrot fractal with the 5000 iterations for the red channel, 500 for the green, and 50 for the blue. Using different numbers of iterations for each channel is known as "Nebulabrot". Up to 64 samples were taken for each pixel. Each channel was then gamma-corrected and normalized. The image depicts the complex plane from -2 to 2 in both the real and imaginary axes. The real axis is vertical whereas the imaginary is horizontal. The image was generated in under 10 minutes with an AMD Ryzen 9 3900X CPU and my open source renderer .
